type:
∀ {α : ℝ},
  Irrational α → IsAlgebraic ℚ α → ∀ {κ : ℝ}, {x : ℚ | |α - ↑x| < 1 / ↑x.den ^ κ}.Infinite → κ ≤ 2
what: Infinitely many distinct rational approximations to an irrational algebraic real, measured by reduced denominator, force exponent at most two.
how: Inject rationals into numerator/denominator pairs via Rat.ext; Rat.cast_def identifies their real error, allowing Roth.roth to bound the exponent.
hypotheses: Real target irrational and algebraic over the rationals, real exponent, infinitely many rational values satisfying the strict unit-coefficient estimate.
caller_summary: No lexical proof/type callers and no canonical293 direct kernel consumers. Intended named public endpoint; retain in the Roth contribution package rather than deleting as dead code.
mathlib_api_audit: Pinned Rat rational-center finiteness and Real exponent2 Infinite iff Irrational support dropping the irrationality binder; they do not prove the algebraic Roth exponent bound. Filter.eventually_cofinite gives the finite-exception interface.
moral_duplications: Same Roth theorem endpoint as Roth.roth with distinct representation semantics; pair irrationality remains necessary. LeanEval uniform strict constant bound is distinct.

generalization.proposed_type: ∀ {α : ℝ}, IsAlgebraic ℚ α → ∀ {κ : ℝ}, {x : ℚ | |α - x| < 1 / (x.den : ℝ) ^ κ}.Infinite → κ ≤ 2
generalization.scope: Compiled implication from the exact original endpoint schema hR; original hR separately re-elaborated and type-agreed. No extra axiom introduced.
generalization.modern: Equivalent finite rational bad-set or cofinite non-strict lower-bound form verified in modern01; not a uniform strict positive-C bound.
generalization.constant: Verified C≤1 extension in edges01. C>1/existential coefficient variant assessed but not claimed compiled.

missing_api: Algebraic real exponent-two Roth theorem is the substantive missing API; add the all-algebraic rational endpoint as a corollary of the coherent theorem package, using existing rational-center finiteness.
junk: No removal: zero internal consumers does not make the explicitly documented public rational endpoint dead. Avoid separate upstream PR for the five-line conversion alone.
action: Generalise away hα, retain original-signature recovery, supply finite/cofinite variants, group with accepted Roth theorem candidates. Proposed Mathlib/NumberTheory/DiophantineApproximation/Roth.lean; run /generalise and /cleanup before PR.
